metadata.review_only_rule: This artifact freezes a review-only ePK ligand-state evidence policy for a future fresh tranche selected after the freeze. It does not activate ePK scoring, select thresholds, edit registries, import labels, or claim held-out performance.

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: draft preregistration is inactive, excludes mechanism text and product-state ADP-without-gamma from predictive use, and requires the policy to be frozen before candidate selection
evidence_basis.policy_implication: freeze is necessary before a fresh tranche, but preregistration alone did not activate scoring

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: activation failed closed with seven blockers, including no calibrated ePK score, no real external hard-negative scored re-audit, and unresolved ligand-analog dependency for m_csa:640
evidence_basis.policy_implication: the ligand-state policy may be frozen as a prospective rule, but production activation still needs evidence

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: active-gamma protein-substrate-or-ligand-analog variant covered 3/3 current positives, had 0 sibling false hits and 0 imported external feature non-abstentions, but failed the freeze-before-selection and scored external re-audit gates
evidence_basis.policy_implication: diagnostic controls support a conservative freeze, not retrospective activation

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: 3TM0 ANP/Mg plus B31 acceptor-like analog geometry closes a review-only gap for m_csa:640, with ANP PG-to-B31 O14 distance 3.558 angstrom
evidence_basis.policy_implication: ANP can be a gamma-capable ATP-state nucleotide analog, but substrate/acceptor analog context remains review-only

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: 5LI1 preserves ANP/Mg and local residue hints but lacks terminal gamma measurement, source-authoritative target residue positions, and mapped protein-substrate acceptor evidence
evidence_basis.policy_implication: structure-level active-state context is insufficient unless terminal gamma, metal, and source-free acceptor/role features co-materialize

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: 5HVK is accepted as source-valid LIMK1/cofilin review evidence with ANP PG-to-Ser3 geometry, but control rerun remains review-only and uncalibrated
evidence_basis.policy_implication: source review may adjudicate outcomes after scoring, but cannot be a predictive feature in a fresh tranche

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: unified prototype gives full review-only signal to eight positive-like rows, blocks current controls and imported external hard negatives, excludes ligand-analog-only m_csa:640, and fails closed because threshold, real external re-audit, registry/factory extension, and production freeze are missing
evidence_basis.policy_implication: fresh-tranche policy must separate source-free predictive ligand-state features from review-only support

evidence_basis.relevant_signal: current ePK lane is review-only, repeated scouts include ATP/Mg, ANP/Mg, AMP-PNP/Mg, ADP/Mg, and product-state surfaces, and no threshold, scorer, registry edit, or label import is authorized
evidence_basis.policy_implication: the frozen policy must fail closed until activation data are collected

answer_summary.q1_predictive_ligand_states: ATP and pre-frozen gamma-capable ATP-state nucleotide analogs, including ANP/AMP-PNP aliases, can be predictive only when terminal gamma-equivalent geometry, local metal context, catalytic-site locality, and source-free acceptor/role features co-materialize in the same structure. ADP, product-state structures, and substrate/acceptor analogs are not predictive.
answer_summary.q2_review_only_states: ADP/Mg, product-state ADP plus phosphorylated product/substrate, substrate or product analog acceptors such as B31/KAN-like context, structure-level SEP/TPO context, and active-state nucleotide structures missing terminal gamma, metal, or source-free acceptor/role evidence are review-only.
answer_summary.q3_forbidden_context: After-the-fact source review, candidate-specific alternate repair, cross-PDB split-state fusion, mechanism prose, entry names, labels, EC/Rhea/UniProt identifiers, source ids, homomeric chain choice, post-hoc ligand-code expansion, and threshold selection after seeing fresh outcomes are forbidden as predictive inputs.
answer_summary.q4_exact_frozen_policy: Use only a pre-frozen ligand alias map and source-free mmCIF-derived local features. Score per structure. Permit ATP/ANP/AMP-PNP active-gamma states only if terminal gamma-equivalent atom, local Mg/Mn-compatible metal, catalytic-site locality, and pre-frozen acceptor/role features are present in the same structure. Otherwise abstain. Keep ADP/product-state/substrate-analog evidence as review-only support. Select the fresh tranche only after this policy and scorer implementation are frozen.
answer_summary.q5_data_before_activation: Collect a fresh post-freeze tranche, fixed query manifest, mmCIF extraction logs, ligand-state calls, active-gamma/metal/acceptor measurements, abstention reasons, sibling-family controls, broad stress controls, real external hard-negative scored re-audit, threshold calibration records, source-review adjudication kept separate from features, and label-factory/registry gate artifacts before activation.

activation_data_requirements.description: Versioned scorer/config implementing this ligand-state policy, including ligand alias map, atom parser, metal rules, abstention rules, duplicate exclusions, and thresholds or threshold-selection protocol.
A fresh ePK evaluation tranche selected only after freeze, with exact query strings, retrieval date, PDB/accession list, exclusion of development rows, and immutable candidate manifest.
Per-row mmCIF-derived ligand-state calls, terminal gamma materialization, metal context, same-structure co-materialization, acceptor/role feature calls, abstention reasons, and parser failures.
Scored NDK, PfkB, PfkA, ATP-grasp, GHMP, dNK, ASKHA, GHKL, and broad topology/query controls under the exact frozen policy, not under a separate review-only feature screen.
A real scored external hard-negative re-audit under the calibrated ePK scorer, not just feature abstention diagnostics.
Threshold selection or abstention policy calibrated on pre-declared calibration data, with fresh tranche held back for evaluation.
Audit proving source review, literature review, phosphosite support, and expert rationale were used only for post-score adjudication or review labels, not predictive feature construction.
A future review-only gate proving fingerprint registry extension, label factory behavior, countable import safety, and production activation criteria are implemented and pass.

warnings: This artifact freezes policy text only; it does not implement a scorer.
Existing current-row and scout evidence remains development/review evidence because it was selected before this freeze.
ADP/product-state and substrate-analog evidence must stay review-only in prospective scoring.
Ligand-state policy can be frozen now for a future fresh tranche, but activation needs more evidence and gate artifacts.
